summary: A stack of disclosures, of which it can keep only one open.

single.description: Opening one disclosure closes the others.

root.note: Stacks its disclosures with a hairline between them.

guidance.text: Its disclosures are its child elements. Each trigger sits inside a heading the author writes, so that the titles are headings to assistive technology.

notYet: Arrow keys that move between the triggers, which APG lists as optional.
